name: Warding Statuette
evidence: "- **Armor** You gain resistance 1 against ranged weapon attacks. - **Weapon** ... you can choose a creature adjacent to the creature that was hit. That creature gains a +1 status bonus to AC until the start of your next turn."

corrections.problem: The evidence and reasoning are paraphrased beyond the record. The text reads 'you can choose a creature adjacent to the creature that was hit. That creature gains a +1 status bonus to AC until the start of your next turn' — it never says ALLY. Since you are a creature and are adjacent to your target after a melee Strike, the wielder can legitimately choose themselves, so this is not unambiguously an other-creature-only buff the way Guardian Staff ('choose an ally within 10 feet') is. Ruling it flatly non-situational with no star may hide a real self-applicable +1 status AC.
corrections.correction: Keep the resistance-1 half excluded (correct), but set needsHumanDecision true with the question: 'The text says any creature adjacent to the one you hit, not an ally — after a melee Strike the wielder qualifies. Should this be a situational +1 status AC on the wielder (condition: after you hit with the affixed weapon, if you are adjacent to the target, until the start of your next turn, max one creature per turn), or stay ally-only pending the ally-buff engine work?' Also strike the word 'ally' from the evidence/reason; it is not in the record.

name: Warding Statuette (Greater)
evidence: "- **Armor** You gain resistance 5 against ranged weapon attacks. - **Weapon** ... That creature gains a +1 status bonus to AC until the start of your next turn."

corrections.problem: Same paraphrase error: reasonIfNot says the +1 status AC 'goes to an adjacent ally', but the verified text is 'you can choose a creature adjacent to the creature that was hit' with no ally restriction, so the wielder can be the chosen creature after a melee Strike.
corrections.correction: Same as the base statuette: keep resistance 5 excluded, drop the invented 'ally' wording, and set needsHumanDecision true asking whether a self-chosen +1 status AC should be starred (condition: after you hit with the affixed weapon while adjacent to the target, until the start of your next turn, one creature per turn).

corrections.problem: needsEngineWork is set to false, but each of these five specs contains a Speed entry with targetKind 'speed'. The live registry cannot carry it: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts declares `kind: 'skill' | 'save' | 'perception' | 'ac' | 'attack'` and there is no 'speed' (nor 'hp'/'strikeDamage') member anywhere in its 330 keys. Authored as-is, the '+5/+10 feet status bonus to your Speed' entries either fail to type-check or get silently dropped, so the very bonus that is hardest for a player to remember (a temporary Speed boost from a mutagen) never reaches a star. The bonus values themselves are correct (verified: lesser +1/+5 ft/1 min, moderate +2/+5 ft/1 min, greater +3/+10 ft/10 min, major +4/+10 ft/1 hr, all with the -1 untyped Perception and Will penalties).
corrections.correction: Set needsEngineWork true on all five, with the note: 'targetKind speed does not exist in SituationalTarget (kinds are skill|save|perception|ac|attack) — the Speed entry needs the union extended before it can be authored.' The same check applies elsewhere in this chunk and was handled correctly there: oil-of-skating (speed) and execution-powder (hp + strikeDamage) already set needsEngineWork true. Note that magnetic-shot's 'strikeAttack' is NOT affected — it maps onto the existing 'attack' kind (precedent: perfect-clarity, you-seem-somewhat-familiar), so needsEngineWork false is right for those four.

name: Heartening Missive

corrections.problem: The umbrella record is registered with THREE simultaneous bonus entries (+1 item Fortitude, +1 item Reflex, +1 item Will). These are four mutually exclusive purchasable variants printed in one book entry — Bull, Butterfly, Rabbit, Turtle (I confirmed all four in the umbrella text, and heartening-missive-butterfly exists as its own id in core.json even though it is not in this chunk). A character can only ever receive one, and only one at a time (the text: '...the recipient gets its benefit and becomes temporarily immune to all heartening missives for 24 hours'). As written, one record lights up all three save stars at once. The spec's own engineNote calls this 'misleading' and then authors it anyway.
corrections.correction: Either drop the bonuses from the umbrella entirely (situational:false, 'book-entry aggregate; the three graded ids carry the real bonuses'), or collapse to a single entry whose `when` makes the exclusivity explicit — e.g. targets [save/fortitude, save/reflex, save/will] with when: 'for 24 hours after receiving a heartening missive — Bull grants Fortitude, Rabbit Reflex, Turtle Will (only one applies, and only the variant you received)'. The three graded specs (bull/rabbit/turtle) are correct as authored and are the ones a real roster will hit. Same umbrella question already flagged for theatrical-mutagen, magnetic-shot, poison-concentrator and black-tendril-shot — it needs one answer applied consistently.

The record's text is narrower than that: "while wearing it, when you roll Perception for initiative, you can roll twice and take the higher result". It is scoped to PERCEPTION-for-initiative, so perception is the exact target and it cannot over-report — a character rolling Stealth for initiative simply doesn't meet the stated condition. This is also the registry's established convention (ambush-awareness: "on Perception checks rolled for initiative").

name: The Empty Throne

currentBonuses.when: to Recall Knowledge about individuals who are no longer alive (a historical founder, not a living monarch)
to Recall Knowledge about individuals who are no longer alive, using any Lore skill

evidence: "+2 item bonus to Society and Lore checks made to Recall Knowledge regarding individuals who are no longer alive" — explicitly excludes living subjects.

corrections.problem: The second bonus entry uses skill key "lore" (bare). Verified against the registry contract: SituationalTarget.detail for kind 'skill' is documented as "a skill key (e.g. `intimidation`), a `lore:*` key, or `all`", and targetMatches() in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts compares with strict equality (`t.detail === ref.skill`). Real lore proficiency keys are `lore:<subject>` (skillLabel() in explain.ts slices `key.slice(5)`), so a bare 'lore' matches NOTHING — the entry is silently dead data, never raising a star. It is also inconsistent with the same engineer's own handling of watch-of-lost-ages, where the identical "any Lore" gap was handled by omitting the entry and flagging it. The card text itself is quoted correctly ("+2 item bonus to Society and Lore checks made to Recall Knowledge regarding individuals who are no longer alive ... increases to a +3 item bonus if you are at least 17th level"), so the Society entry, the +2/+3 sizing, the item type and the condition are all right.
corrections.correction: Drop the `skill: "lore"` entry (keep the Society one) and leave needsEngineWork true with the note that an "any Lore" wildcard is required — matching the watch-of-lost-ages treatment. If a wildcard is added first, author it as `lore:*` (the docstring's own wording) AND extend targetMatches to honour it: `t.detail === 'lore:*' && ref.skill?.startsWith('lore:')`. As currently written the entry ships a key that can never match.

name: Canary

currentBonuses.when: to Gather Information about the person, locale, rumor or troop movement a basic canary informant was hired for
to Gather Information on that subject if you paid for advanced informant services
to Gather Information on the movements and mannerisms of a person a canary tail has been following

evidence: "A canary informant automatically Aids you on attempts to Gather Information … granting you a +1 circumstance bonus"; advanced informants give +2; tails give +1 per week "up to a maximum of four weeks for a +4 bonus".

corrections.problem: needsEngineWork is set to false on all six canary records (canary, canary-informant-basic-services, canary-informant-advanced-services, canary-tail-first-week/second/third/fourth), but the entries can never fire. characterSituationalIds() in src/rules/explain.ts only admits an inventory row when `inv.equipped || inv.worn || inv.invested` ("An ITEM only counts while it is actually in use"). A canary is a purchased hireling service — the record has no `usage` field at all (confirmed: usage undefined, price 2/5/10/20/40/80 gp, listed as "Ammunition per target, per day" / "per week"), so it is never equipped, worn or invested. The bonus text itself is quoted accurately and the Gather Information → Diplomacy mapping and the +1/+2 circumstance types are correct.
corrections.correction: Set needsEngineWork true on all six canary records with the note: hireling/service items have no equipped/worn/invested state, so the current item gating in characterSituationalIds() will never surface them; they need either a "service is active" flag on the inventory row or a separate non-item lane. This also makes the existing needsHumanDecision question concrete — today the answer is moot because nothing would display either way.

name: The Publican
evidence: "treat critically failed checks made to Aid as regular failures instead. If you are at least 14th level, the circumstance bonus you provide … increases by 1."

corrections.problem: situational is true while bonuses is an empty array — a self-contradicting shape. The record text is quoted correctly and the reasoning is right ("treat critically failed checks made to Aid as regular failures instead" is a degree-of-success shift with no numeric modifier, and "the circumstance bonus you provide for succeeding or critically succeeding at checks to Aid increases by 1" boosts what ANOTHER creature receives), but a downstream applier that keys off `situational === true` will emit `'the-publican': []`, an entry that stars nothing and reads as an authoring mistake later.
corrections.correction: Either set situational false with the existing explanation moved into reasonIfNot (nothing on this card is a bonus to one of your own stats), or keep situational true only if the project's convention is "situational but unrepresentable" — and state that convention explicitly. Keep needsEngineWork true and the human-decision question either way; do not leave true + empty as-is.

name: The Rabbit Prince

currentBonuses.when: on attack rolls you make as a readied action

evidence: "grants you a +1 status bonus to attack rolls you make as a readied action" — only on readied attacks.

corrections.problem: Under-coverage. The standing bonus is captured correctly ("grants you a +1 status bonus to attack rolls you make as a readied action" → strikeAttack, +1 status), but the activation was dismissed as "a fortune effect, not a standing bonus". The record's Effect reads "Reroll the triggering Strike with a +1 status bonus" — the fortune part is the reroll; the +1 status is a separate, genuinely situational typed bonus to an attack roll under a stated condition (Trigger: "You miss a creature with a melee weapon Strike", Frequency once per day), which is exactly what this registry is for.
corrections.correction: Add a second entry: bonus "+1 status", targetKind strikeAttack, when "on the once-per-day reroll after you miss a creature with a melee weapon Strike (Activate, reaction)". Low impact — the card already stars strikeAttack via the readied-action entry, so no star is lost, only the popup line.

name: Hexing Jar

currentBonuses.when: until the start of your next turn after Activating the jar (5 actions, once per hour) — triggered by a critical success on an attack roll with a witch spell, or a target critically failing its save against your witch spell or hex
until the start of your next turn after that same activation
against mental effects, until the start of your next turn after that same activation

evidence: 5-action activation, "Trigger You roll a critical success on an attack roll with a witch spell, or your target rolls a critical failure on its saving throw against a witch spell or hex you cast" → "granting you and your familiar a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws and a +2 status bonus against mental effects" until the start of your next turn.

corrections.problem: The `when` text and the evidence both call the triggered activation a "5-action activation" / "5 actions". In core.json the description reads `**Activate** ⟨5⟩ (concentrate)` and `src/sheet/widgets.tsx` maps glyph char "5" to a REACTION (char "4" = free action, only 1-3 are literal action counts). A 5-action cost is impossible in PF2e, and this string is printed to the player at the table. Secondary: the text is "a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws and a +2 status bonus against mental effects" — the +2 is parallel to "AC and saving throws", so restricting it to saves only is a narrowing the sentence does not support.
corrections.correction: Reword both `when` strings to "until the start of your next turn after Activating the jar (reaction, once per hour) — triggered by a critical success on an attack roll with a witch spell, or a target critically failing its save against your witch spell or hex". Consider adding a fourth entry `{bonus:'+2 status', when:'against mental effects, until the start of your next turn after that activation', targetKind:'ac'}` alongside the save entry, or flag the AC/save scope of the +2 as needsHumanDecision. Everything else in this spec is confirmed: the trigger wording, the +1 status AC/saves, the unconditional +2 item bonus to the patron skill (hexing-jar has NO passiveEffects/dynamicSkillBonus in core.json, so that gap is real), and the unrepresentable familiar half.

name: Whisperer of Souls

currentBonuses.when: on an Occultism check to Decipher Writing, Identify Magic, Learn a Spell, or Recall Knowledge, if you spend the glaive's 4-action activation to listen to it

evidence: Activation (4 actions, concentrate), "Trigger You attempt an Occultism check to Decipher Writing, Identify Magic, Learn a Spell, or Recall Knowledge" → "gaining a +4 item bonus to the triggering check."

corrections.problem: `when` says "if you spend the glaive's 4-action activation to listen to it". The record reads `**Activate** ⟨4⟩ (concentrate)` and glyph "4" is a FREE ACTION per src/sheet/widgets.tsx, not four actions. It also has a Trigger, which confirms it is not a 4-action activity.
corrections.correction: Change `when` to "on an Occultism check to Decipher Writing, Identify Magic, Learn a Spell, or Recall Knowledge, if you Activate the glaive (free action) to listen to it". The +4 item bonus, the target (skill/occultism), and the four listed uses are all confirmed correct.

name: Corruption Cassock

currentBonuses.when: only if you worship the cassock's true unholy deity — while you remain loyal to any other deity the bonus does not exist (the GM secretly negates it)
to the divine skill of the cassock's deity, and only if you worship that true unholy deity — otherwise the bonus does not exist

evidence: "While you remain loyal to another deity, you believe the cassock grants you a +2 item bonus to Religion checks and a +1 item bonus to the divine skill of the deity to whom you believe the cassock is dedicated. It does neither… If you convert to following the cassock's true unholy deity, however, these bonuses function normally for you."

corrections.problem: Marked situational:true, but the deity clause is exactly the same all-or-nothing eligibility gate this same engineer correctly classified as situational:false on cloister-robe ("The robe doesn't grant any benefits to a wearer who doesn't worship the deity tied to the robe"). The cassock text is "While you remain loyal to another deity, you believe the cassock grants you a +2 item bonus... It does neither... If you convert to following the cassock's true unholy deity, however, these bonuses function normally for you." There are only two states: bonus absent entirely, or bonus permanent and unconditional. Neither is a per-check circumstance. Worse, flagging it situational makes the sheet print the condition text "only if you worship the cassock's true unholy deity" by default — which spoils the GM's secret, the very thing the spec's own needsHumanDecision asks about.
corrections.correction: Set situational:false with reasonIfNot "once you worship the cassock's true unholy deity the +2 item to Religion / +1 item to that deity's divine skill are permanent; while you worship anyone else they do not exist at all. Item-level eligibility gate, not a per-roll condition." Keep needsHumanDecision (cursed-item display policy) and keep the engineNote about the suppression rule and the dynamic divine skill — both are accurate. Note core.json already has a `dynamicSkillBonus: {source: 'bloodline'|'deity', value}` lane wired into src/rules/derive.ts line 244, which is the natural home for the deity-skill half.

name: Druid's Crown
evidence: "The crown grants you a +1 item bonus to a skill, and can be activated to cast a spell, both depending on the material used to build the crown" (Antlers→Intimidation, Flowers→Diplomacy, Leaves→Stealth); "If you invest and wear living mantle along with the crown, the crown's item bonus increases by 1".

corrections.problem: The needsHumanDecision question rests on a false premise. It asks whether the crown "should carry a player-facing material picker (like the Doubling Rings rune-copy picker) that drives a real item bonus, or stay display-only text". The core.json record ALREADY has `effectChoices: [{id:'crown-material', prompt:"Choose the crown's material (+1 item bonus)", options: antlers→intimidation 1 / flowers→diplomacy 1 / leaves→stealth 1}]`, i.e. the picker exists and already grants a real passive item bonus. Asking the owner to decide something already built wastes a decision cycle, and the question omits the part that IS unmodelled.
corrections.correction: Drop the picker question. The classification (situational:false) is correct and should stand. Replace the question with the real gap: the three effectChoices options hard-code +1, but the text says "If you invest and wear living mantle along with the crown, the crown's item bonus increases by 1" — living-mantle exists in core.json as its own invested item and nothing escalates the crown to +2 when both are invested. Also keep the druid-only investiture gate note ("You can invest this item only if you're a druid").

name: Unfathomable Stargazer

currentBonuses.when: on checks to observe the night sky through the telescope (which use Occultism in place of Perception or Astronomy Lore)
to Survival checks to Sense Direction or navigate, once the telescope has fused to you

evidence: "You use Occultism instead of Perception or Astronomy Lore when observing the skies with this item, and gain a +2 item bonus on all checks to do so." And: "The telescope imposes a –4 circumstance penalty to Survival checks to Sense Direction or navigate."

corrections.problem: The penalty entry's `when` reads "to Survival checks to Sense Direction or navigate, once the telescope has fused to you". The record says flatly "The telescope imposes a –4 circumstance penalty to Survival checks to Sense Direction or navigate." — there is no "once fused" qualifier on that sentence. Fusing is described in the preceding sentence about using another device to observe stars ("Once you use it, it fuses to you, and you must succeed at a save to use another device to observe the stars"), and the spec has carried that qualifier across into an unrelated clause. This is a condition invented beyond the text, and it materially understates the curse (a player who has not yet activated it would think they are unaffected).
corrections.correction: Change `when` to "to Survival checks to Sense Direction or navigate, while you have the telescope" (no fusion gate). Keep the needsHumanDecision about whether penalties belong in this bonus registry — that question is legitimate. The +2 item entry (skill/occultism, on checks to observe the night sky) and the note that the Occultism-for-Perception substitution is unrepresentable are both confirmed correct.

name: The Hidden Truth

currentBonuses.when: to Recall Knowledge with a Lore skill
on any check made to Research (Gamemastery Guide Research subsystem)

evidence: "As long as this card is invested, you gain a +2 item bonus to Lore checks made to Recall Knowledge, and to all checks made to Research while using the Research subsystem from the Gamemastery Guide. This increases to a +3 bonus if you are at least 17th level."

corrections.problem: Invalid target detail. The spec emits `targetKind: "skill", skill: "lore"`, but `lore` is not a value the registry can resolve. The real contract in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts documents `SituationalTarget.detail` for kind `skill` as "a skill key (e.g. `intimidation`), a `lore:*` key, or `all` (any skill)" — there is no bare `lore` skill. The engineNote also claims "existing registry precedent uses detail 'lore:*'"; that is false — I scanned all 416 lines and NO entry uses a `lore:` detail (it exists only in the doc comment). As written this entry would silently match nothing, so the star never appears — the exact bug this whole effort is meant to fix.
corrections.correction: Keep situational: true and the +2/+3 item bonus (text confirmed verbatim: "you gain a +2 item bonus to Lore checks made to Recall Knowledge ... This increases to a +3 bonus if you are at least 17th level"). Change the first entry's target to a resolvable one — either fan out to one entry per Lore the character actually has (`skill`/`lore:<name>`), or use `skill`/`all` with the condition text carrying the restriction: when = "to Recall Knowledge, but only with a Lore skill". Do not leave `skill: "lore"`.

corrections.problem: Missing a target. The record says the activation grants "a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the creature and to your AC and saving throws against attacks and effects from the creature". "Attack rolls" in PF2e includes SPELL attack rolls, not just Strikes. The spec emits only strikeAttack, ac and save/all — so a caster (the exact character who wears an Intelligence apex item and studies a foe) gets no marker on the one stat they actually roll. The prompt's target list includes `spell`, so no invention is required.
corrections.correction: Add a fourth entry: { bonus: "+1 circumstance (+2 if you critically succeeded the Recall Knowledge)", when: "for 1 minute, on spell attack rolls against the creature you studied with the 1-action activation", targetKind: "spell" }.
